name: lattr.autobefores
doc: A boolean indicating whether or not before.field layouts are automatically repeated at the top of a page if the page break does not correspond with a sort break. The default value is true. (R/W)

name: lattr.autoreset
doc: A boolean indicating whether or not Report script functions is automatically performed in the case of breaks of layouts in sorting fields. The default value is true. (R/W)

name: lattr.break
doc: A boolean that is set to true during printing of before.field layouts when the layout is printed as the result of a sort field change. It is set to false when a before.field layout is printed because of a page break. (R)

name: lattr.enddata
doc: A boolean indicating whether or not the end of the data has been reached. (R)

name: lattr.header
doc: A boolean that is set to true during printing of header layouts and during printing of before.field layouts at the top of a page. (R)

name: lattr.language$
doc: The language code of the report. (R)

name: lattr.lineno
doc: The current line number. (R)

name: lattr.multicol
doc: Indicates whether or not multiple columns are used when more than one layout fits on a line. Possible values are: MULTICOL_NONE Normal output; no columns are used. MULTICOL_ORDER_HORIZONTAL Output is arranged in multiple columns, ordered horizontally. For example: rec_1 rec_2 rec_3 rec_4 rec_5 rec_6 MULTICOL_ORDER_VERTICAL Output is arranged in multiple columns, ordered vertically (per page). For example: rec_1 rec_3 rec_5 rec_2 rec_4 rec_6 (R/W)

name: lattr.multicol.count
doc: Specifies the number of columns to use when multiple columns are specified (see lattr.multicol). The default value is 0. In this case, the report manager calculates the number of columns based of the report width and the layout width. (R/W)

name: lattr.multicol.repeat
doc: A boolean indicating whether headers and footers are automatically repeated for each column. The default value is true. The width of the header and footer layouts width must be equal to or less than the width of the detail layout. (R/W)

name: lattr.pageno
doc: Current page number. (R/W)

name: lattr.print
doc: Indicates whether or not a layout is to be printed. (R/W)

name: lattr.prline
doc: After expansion of a variable in a report, this is filled with the text line that is printed. (R/W)

name: lattr.recordtimes
doc: Indicates the number of times the layout will be printed. (R/W)

name: lattr.textexpand
doc: A boolean indicating whether or not variables included in text fields can be expanded. The default is false. (R/W)

name: lattr.textlang$
doc: The language code for printing text. The default is the language code of the report. (R/W)

name: lattr.textline
doc: A string containing the source text line from the text manager. (R)

name: lattr.textlineno
doc: The number of the line that must be printed. (R)

name: lattr.textlines.max
doc: The maximum number of lines in the layout. (R/W)

name: lattr.textlines.min
doc: The minimum number of lines in the layout. (R/W)

name: sattr.descr$
doc: Description of the session.
